A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we introduce a new training procedure for sequence models that can better utilize beam decoding.
we introduce a continuous relaxation of beam search, and show that it can be used to train models that are more effective at beam decoding.
we propose a novel objective that allows us to train a neural model to directly optimize for the final loss metric of the test-time decoding algorithm.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to improve the performance of cross entropy training for neural sequence models by explicitly considering the behaviour of the test-time decoding procedure.
it is possible to directly optimize a beam search decoding procedure for neural models and this can yield substantial gains over standard cross entropy training.
it is possible to design training objectives that are tailored towards specific downstream applications.
